userStories.title: Verifier emits structured findings from categorized rejection reasons
acceptanceCriteria: Given a `VerifierVerdict` where `categorizeVerdict(verdict, ...).success === false` and `categorizeVerdict(verdict, ...).failureCategory === "tests-failing"`, when `parseVerdictFromStdout` returns its `VerifierOutput`, then `output.normalizedFindings` is a non-empty `Finding[]` and each entry has `source === "tdd-verifier"`, `severity === "error"`, `category === "tests-failed"`, `fixTarget === "source"`, and a non-empty `message`.

Given a `VerifierVerdict` where `categorizeVerdict(verdict, ...).success === true` (including verdicts rejected for advisory `acceptanceCriteria` / `quality` reasons only), when `parseVerdictFromStdout` returns its `VerifierOutput`, then `output.normalizedFindings.length === 0`.

Given a `VerifierVerdict` where `categorizeVerdict(verdict, ...).failureCategory === "verifier-rejected"` (illegitimate test modifications), when `parseVerdictFromStdout` returns its `VerifierOutput`, then `output.normalizedFindings` contains exactly one entry with `source === "tdd-verifier"`, `severity === "error"`, `category === "illegitimate-test-edits"`, and `fixTarget === "test"`.
`src/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.ts` contains exactly one line matching the regex `^const IMPLEMENTER_SOURCES = new Set\(\["lint", "typecheck", "semantic-review", "tdd-verifier"\]\);$`.
`src/operations/_finding-to-check.ts` contains exactly one line matching the regex `^\s*"tdd-verifier": "test",\s*$` inside the `SOURCE_TO_CHECK` object literal.

Given `phaseOutputs["verifier"]` set to a `VerifierOutput` whose `normalizedFindings` is `[F1, F2]`, when `extractPhaseFindings(phaseOutputs["verifier"])` is called, then it returns an array containing `F1` and `F2`.

`src/prompts/index.ts` exports the symbol `RectifierPromptBuilder`, and `src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts` contains exactly one `static verifierContext(` method definition on the `RectifierPromptBuilder` class.
`src/prompts/sections/verdict.ts` is byte-identical to its state at SHA `52634c0b` (this PR does not modify the verifier prompt schema; PR #1138 owns that surface).
suggestedCriteria: `buildVerifierFindings(verdict, categorization)` returns `[]` when `categorization.failureCategory` is undefined or does not match any known case (defensive default branch).

Given a verdict produced by `coerceVerdict` (synthesised defaults for missing optional fields), when `parseVerdictFromStdout` processes its raw output, then `output.normalizedFindings` is populated correctly for `tests-failing` and `verifier-rejected` categories without throwing on missing optional fields.
The `recover` path in `verifierOp` — when a verdict is successfully read from disk and `categorization.success === false` — returns a `VerifierOutput` whose `normalizedFindings` is non-empty.
The fail-closed path in `verifierOp.recover` (no usable verdict file on disk) returns a `VerifierOutput` with `normalizedFindings: []`.

Given `findingsToFailedChecks` called with only `lint`, `typecheck`, and `semantic-review` findings (no `tdd-verifier` source), the returned `ReviewCheckResult[]` is identical to pre-change behavior — no `"test"` check entry appears unless a test-runner source is present.
`RectifierPromptBuilder.verifierContext([])` returns a non-empty fallback string and does not throw.
`extractPhaseFindings` is exported from `src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` with a JSDoc comment stating it is exported for unit testing.

userStories.title: Cycle exit honesty: ValidateResult type and short-circuit flag
acceptanceCriteria: `src/findings/cycle-types.ts` contains exactly one line matching the regex `^\s*\|\s*"validate-short-circuit"\s*$` inside the `FixCycleExitReason` union.

`src/findings/cycle-types.ts` contains a `ValidateResult` interface declaration with exactly two members named `findings` (typed `readonly F[]`) and `shortCircuited` (typed `readonly boolean` and optional via `?:`).

Given a `FixCycle.validate` callback that returns `{ findings: [], shortCircuited: true }` from the terminal lite-validate, when `runFixCycle` exits, then the returned `FixCycleResult.exitReason === "validate-short-circuit"` (NOT `"resolved"`) and `finalFindings.length === 0`.

Given a `FixCycle` whose strategies are all at their per-strategy attempt cap AND whose terminal lite-validate callback returns `{ findings: [], shortCircuited: false }`, when `runFixCycle` exits, then the returned `FixCycleResult.exitReason === "resolved"` (the terminal-branch path, not the loop-top early exit at `cycle.ts:158-160`).

Given a `FixCycle.validate` callback that returns a bare `Finding[]` (legacy shape) from the terminal lite-validate, when `runFixCycle` exits, then the returned `FixCycleResult.exitReason === "resolved"` if the array is empty, mirroring pre-change behaviour (backwards compatibility with `acceptance-loop.ts:297` and `run-regression.ts:345`).
suggestedCriteria: `normalizeValidateResult([] as Finding[])` returns `{ findings: [], shortCircuited: false }`.
`normalizeValidateResult({ findings: [F1], shortCircuited: true })` returns the object unchanged (not double-wrapped).

Given a `FixCycle.validate` callback that returns `{ findings: [F1], shortCircuited: true }` from the terminal lite-validate, when `runFixCycle` exits, then `FixCycleResult.exitReason === "validate-short-circuit"` and `finalFindings` contains `F1`.
The rectification validate callback in `story-orchestrator.ts` returns `{ findings: [], shortCircuited: true }` when a phase fails with no extracted findings and the loop breaks early.
The per-iteration full validate call site in `cycle.ts` uses `normalizeValidateResult` — a non-terminal short-circuit does not cause `exitReason: "validate-short-circuit"` and iteration continues.

userStories.title: Resume guard and RectificationResult: wire validate-short-circuit to liteScopeIncomplete
acceptanceCriteria: `src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` contains exactly one line matching the regex `^\s*"validate-short-circuit",\s*$` inside the `EXHAUSTED_EXIT_REASONS` set literal.
`src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` contains the field declaration `liteScopeIncomplete\?: boolean;` inside the `RectificationResult` interface.

Given `runRectification` consuming a `FixCycleResult` with `exitReason === "validate-short-circuit"` and `finalFindings.length === 0`, when it returns, then the returned `RectificationResult` has `liteScopeIncomplete === true` and `rectificationExhausted` is `undefined`.

Given `runRectification` consuming a `FixCycleResult` with `exitReason === "validate-short-circuit"` and `finalFindings.length > 0`, when it returns, then the returned `RectificationResult` has `rectificationExhausted === true`, `unfixedFindings === cycleResult.finalFindings`, and `liteScopeIncomplete` is `undefined`.

Given `ExecutionPlan.run` with a `rectResult` of `{ rectificationExhausted: true }` (no `liteScopeIncomplete`), when control reaches the resume guard, then the post-rectification-resume block is NOT entered (no further `runPhase` calls beyond `runRectification`).
Given `ExecutionPlan.run` with a `rectResult` of `{ liteScopeIncomplete: true }`, when control reaches the resume guard, then the post-rectification-resume block IS entered.

Given a mocked story run where verifier returns `VerifierOutput { success: false, normalizedFindings: [F_tests_failed] }` and `autofix-implementer` resolves the finding on its first attempt, when `ExecutionPlan.run` completes, then (a) the verifier op was dispatched exactly **once** before story success, AND (b) the rectifier prompt assembled for the autofix-implementer dispatch contains the verifier-context section produced by `RectifierPromptBuilder.verifierContext` (asserting the new builder method is actually invoked end-to-end, not merely defined).

Given a mocked story run replicating the tier-2 lite-scope-incomplete path (verifier short-circuits validate with `normalizedFindings: []`, full-suite-gate is in the canonical phase list but absent from `phaseOutputs`), when `ExecutionPlan.run` completes, then `runRectification` returns `liteScopeIncomplete: true` and the resume block dispatches the full-suite-gate phase.
suggestedCriteria: Given `runRectification` consuming a `FixCycleResult` with `exitReason === "max-attempts-per-strategy"` and `finalFindings.length > 0`, when it returns, then `rectificationExhausted === true` (existing exhausted path still works after adding `"validate-short-circuit"` to `EXHAUSTED_EXIT_REASONS`).
Given `runRectification` consuming a `FixCycleResult` with `exitReason === "resolved"`, when it returns, then `RectificationResult` has neither `rectificationExhausted` nor `liteScopeIncomplete` set.
`runRectification` is exported from `src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts` with a JSDoc comment stating it is exported for unit testing.

Given `ExecutionPlan.run` with `rectResult === {}` (the default clean return), when control reaches the resume guard, then the post-rectification-resume block IS entered (baseline: `!undefined === true`).

analysis:
Two coordinated bug fixes to eliminate redundant verifier dispatches during rectification.

## Key files and current state

### src/operations/verify.ts (lines 25-37)
`VerifierOutput` interface has no `normalizedFindings` field. `parseVerdictFromStdout` (lines 45-67) calls `categorizeVerdict` and discards the categorization — only propagates `failureCategory` and `reviewReason`, never building a `Finding[]`. The `recover` path (lines 128-163) has the same omission and also needs `normalizedFindings` populated. `extractPhaseFindings` in story-orchestrator.ts (lines 393-410) already reads `normalizedFindings` first (`Array.isArray(record.normalizedFindings)`), then `findings` — so once the field is populated on `VerifierOutput`, the wiring needs no change.

### src/findings/cycle-types.ts (lines 57-64, 167-191)
`FixCycleExitReason` union (lines 57-64) is missing `"validate-short-circuit"`. `FixCycle.validate` returns `Promise<F[]>` (line 184) — needs to widen to `Promise<F[] | ValidateResult<F>>` with a `normalizeValidateResult` helper in `cycle.ts`. No `ValidateResult` interface exists yet.

### src/findings/cycle.ts (lines 298-382)
Terminal lite-validate branch (line 309) calls `cycle.validate` and assigns raw `F[]`. At line 352, if `liteFindingsAfter.length === 0`, it exits as `"resolved"` regardless of whether validate actually completed all phases — no short-circuit detection.

### src/operations/_finding-to-check.ts (lines 11-16)
`SOURCE_TO_CHECK` maps `"semantic-review"`, `"adversarial-review"`, `"lint"`, `"typecheck"` to `ReviewCheckName` values. `"tdd-verifier"` is absent, so `findingsToFailedChecks` silently drops verifier findings at line 30.

### src/operations/autofix-implementer-strategy.ts (line 11)
`IMPLEMENTER_SOURCES` is `new Set(["lint", "typecheck", "semantic-review"])`. The `appliesTo` predicate at line 20 gates on both `fixTarget === "source"` AND `IMPLEMENTER_SOURCES.has(f.source)`, so verifier findings with `fixTarget: "source"` are silently excluded from the implementer strategy.

### src/prompts/builders/rectifier-builder.ts (line 857)
`failingTestContext` reads `f.file` and `f.rule` — verifier findings have neither field (they carry `meta.reasoning` and `message`). A separate `verifierContext` static method is needed. `RectifierPromptBuilder` is already exported from `src/prompts/index.ts` (line 40).

### src/execution/story-orchestrator.ts
- `EXHAUSTED_EXIT_REASONS` (lines 52-58, exported): missing `"validate-short-circuit"`.
- `RectificationResult` (lines 828-831, internal): only `rectificationExhausted` and `unfixedFindings` fields — no `liteScopeIncomplete`.
- `validate` callback (lines 876-910): returns bare `findings` array; the short-circuit `break` at line 906 does NOT set any flag.
- Exit logic (lines 953-957): `EXHAUSTED_EXIT_REASONS.has(cycleResult.exitReason)` gates `rectificationExhausted` — `"validate-short-circuit"` is not in the set.
- Resume guard (line 1042): `!rectResult.rectificationExhausted` — cannot distinguish exhausted from lite-scope-incomplete.
- `extractPhaseFindings` (line 393) and `runRectification` (line 833) are **not exported**. The codebase pattern for unit-testable internal functions is `export` with a JSDoc comment (see `refreshReviewInputForDispatch` at line 77: "Exported for unit testing; not for external callers"). Both functions need to be exported following this pattern so AC6 and AC16/AC17 can be tested as unit tests.

## Impact areas and risks

1. **`FixCycle.validate` signature change** — Two external callers (`acceptance-loop.ts:297`, `run-regression.ts:345`) return bare `F[]` and must continue working via `normalizeValidateResult`. AC13 pins backward compat.
2. **`recover` path in verifierOp** — Must also call `buildVerifierFindings` and set `normalizedFindings`. The fail-closed path (missing verdict file) must set `normalizedFindings: []`.
3. **Lost tier-2 lucky recovery** — After C, verifier short-circuits carry non-empty findings (post-A) → `rectificationExhausted = true` → resume skipped. The regression is now driven via `autofix-implementer`. Regression replay validation is a blocker.
4. **`VerdictCategorization` import** — Exported from `src/tdd/verdict.ts` (line 74). `verify.ts` already imports from `"../tdd/verdict"`. No new import path needed.
5. **`FailureCategory` values** — Defined in `src/execution/types.ts` (line 17) as `"tests-failing"` and `"verifier-rejected"`. Note: the finding `category` field (a free-form string) uses `"tests-failed"` (not `"tests-failing"`) to distinguish it from the `FailureCategory` value.

## Story ordering

US-001 → US-002 → US-003. US-001 populates `normalizedFindings` so verifier short-circuits carry findings. US-002 adds `ValidateResult` and the `shortCircuited` flag; the validate callback change depends on `normalizedFindings` being populated. US-003 wires `"validate-short-circuit"` into `RectificationResult` and the resume guard — AC20 (integration) requires verifier findings from US-001, making the transitive dependency real.
